description: Onyx - The context layer powered by all your apps
notes: Onyx Community Edition is MIT licensed; files under 'ee' directories are covered by the Onyx Enterprise License.
User data is stored under %APPDATA% (outside the app directory) and is not persisted by Scoop.

Only the 64-bit MSI is extractable; the arm64 build ships solely as a Tauri NSIS installer (Onyx_arm64.exe) that Scoop cannot unpack - install it manually, or use the 64-bit MSI via Windows ARM emulation.
